question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Amass
solution: The correct answer is **'Gather.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Amass **means *gathering together or accumulating a large amount or number of materials or things over a period of time. *(**इकट्ठा करना, एकत्र करना**) • **Synonyms:** collect, stockpile, assemble, pile up, hoard, congregate. • **Antonyms:** dissipate, dispense, divide, scatter, disburse, spend. • **Example:** **Amass **of wooden pallets is stored in a godown by the workers as they completed a huge production in a month to fulfill the demands of the customer. • **Gather **means *come together; assemble or accumulate.* (**संग्रहित करना, जमा करना, इकट्ठा करना, ****एकत्र करना**) • **Synonyms:** congregate, convene, meet, converge, put together, muster. • **Antonyms:** scatter, disperse, cancel, disassemble, miss, leave, reject, spread. • **Example:** Anakama **gathers **a large amount of garbage that she stored for three days and throws it in a trash truck. From the above meaning, it is evident that Gather is the same meaning as the word Amass. Hence, option 1) Gather is the correct synonym for the word Amass. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Spread **means *opening out something so as to extend its surface area, width, or length, grow, increase, broaden, escalate, and proliferation. *(**फैलाना, विस्तार करना**) • **Divide **means* to separate into different parts, split, dissect, cleave, bisect, disjoin, halve, allocate, and apportion.* (**विभाजन करना, बांटना**) • **Scatter **means *throw in various random directions, disperse, disband, break up, deflect, diffuse.* (**बिखराव, फैलाव, प्रसार**) 3a:T1474, The correct answer is **'Incredible.'**
